[[File:Compound of twenty octahedra.stl|thumb|3D model of a compound of twenty octahedra]]
The '''compound of twenty octahedra''' is a [[uniform polyhedron compound]]. It's composed of a symmetric arrangement of 20 [[octahedron|octahedra]] (considered as triangular [[antiprisms]]). It is a special case of the [[compound of twenty octahedra with rotational freedom|compound of 20 octahedra with rotational freedom]], in which pairs of octahedral vertices coincide.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Skilling |first=J. |date=May 1976 |title=Uniform compounds of uniform polyhedra |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/product/identifier/S0305004100052440/type/journal_article |journal=Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society |language=en |volume=79 |issue=3 |pages=447–457 |doi=10.1017/S0305004100052440 |issn=0305-0041|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

== Related polyhedra ==

This compound shares its [[edge arrangement]] with the [[great dirhombicosidodecahedron]], the [[great disnub dirhombidodecahedron]], and the [[compound of twenty tetrahemihexahedra]].

It may be constructed as the [[exclusive or]] of the two [[enantiomorphs]] of the [[great snub dodecicosidodecahedron]].
